blocks.prompt: 7. A train moving at 54 km/h is accelerated uniformly to 90 km/h in 20 s. Find the acceleration and the distance covered in this time.
blocks.explanation:
Train ki raftaar uniformly barhti hai, yani acceleration constant hai; is liye motion ki equations lagengi.
Diya kya hai? u = 54 km/h, v = 90 km/h, t = 20 s.
Find kya karna hai? Acceleration aur is dauran tay kiya gaya faasla.
Plan: dono speeds ko m/s mein badlein, phir \(v = u + at\) se a, phir \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) se x.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(u = 54\) km/h, \(v = 90\) km/h, \(t = 20\) s.
Maloom karna: acceleration \(a\) aur faasla \(x\).
Tareeqa: constant acceleration ki equations of motion (7.1.6). Time seconds mein hai, is liye dono speeds pehle m/s mein badalni hongi, taake saare units ek jaise hon.

Speeds ko m/s mein badlein
\[u = 54 \times \dfrac{5}{18} = 15\text{ m/s}\]
\[v = 90 \times \dfrac{5}{18} = 25\text{ m/s}\]
Kyun: 1 km/h = 1000 m / 3600 s = 5/18 m/s. 54 ko 18 se divide karein to 3, phir 5 se multiply to 15; isi tarah 90 se 25.
Dhyan dein: sirf ek speed badal kar doosri ko km/h mein chhor dena aam ghalti hai.

\(v = u + at\) se acceleration
\[25 = 15 + a(20)\]
\[20a = 10 \Rightarrow a = 0.5\text{ m/s}^2\]
Kyun: is equation mein sirf a maloom nahi. 15 ko doosri taraf le gaye to 20a = 10 bacha. Matlab har second train ki raftaar 0.5 m/s barhti hai.

\(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) se faasla
\[x = 15(20) + \tfrac{1}{2}(0.5)(20)^2\]
\[= 300 + 100 = 400\text{ m}\]
Kyun: ab u, a aur t teeno maloom hain. Train ek hi direction mein chalti hai, is liye yahi distance hai. Pehla hissa 300 m woh hai jo train purani raftaar se chalti, aur 100 m tez hone ki wajah se izafi hai.

Tasdeeq: \(2ax = v^2 - u^2\) se
\[2(0.5)(400) = 400\]
\[25^2 - 15^2 = 625 - 225 = 400 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: teesri equation bhi wohi jawab deti hai. Graph se bhi: velocity-time graph ke neeche trapezium ka area \(\frac{1}{2}(15 + 25)(20) = 400\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(a = 0.5\) m/s\(^2\); tay kiya gaya faasla \(= 400\) m
